test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: Who among the following poets had composed Prayaga Prashasti in Sanskrit?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harishena**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sanskrit poet**, **panegyrist**, and **government minister Harisena **lived in the **fourth century**.
 
• He had a **significant role **in the **court of Samudragupta**, the **Gupta emperor**.
 
• His most **well-known poem**, which is **inscribed on the Allahabad Pillar **and was composed around **345 CE**, **praises Samudragupta's valour**.
 
• **Allahabad Prashasti **is also known **Prayag Prashasti**.
 
 
• It is a **pillar inscription **of **Samudragupta **found at **Allahabad **and written **in Sanskrit**.
 
• It is **one of the important epigraphic sources **to know about the **political history of the Guptas**.
 
• There are **thirty-three lines in total**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tansen **was a **significant character **in the **North Indian school **of **Hindustani classical music**. He was **an Indian musician **and **poet **who **was born c. 1500 in Behata or Gwalior**, India, and **was buried there in 1586 or 1589**. He was **highly regarded **for **his vocal performances **as well as **his dhrupad and raga compositions**.
 
• **Kalidasa **was a **Classical Sanskrit author **and is frequently regarded as the **best poet **and **playwright of ancient India**. The **Vedas**, the **Ramayana**, **the Mahbarata**, and the **Puranas **are the **main sources **for **his plays and poems**. Three plays, two epic poems, and two shorter poems are all that are left of his writings.
 
• At the time, **Gujarat's capital city **of **Shrimala **was home to the **Sanskrit poet Magha**. Magha was raised **by Shrimali Brahmins**. He was **the grandson of Suprabhadeva **and the **son of Dattaka Sarvacharya.**
